scope: New York official self-help and forms
lawfulUseBoundary: Public ideas and patterns only; no protected code, text, data, branding, trade dress, access-control bypass or confidential material copied.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 and WCAG 2 Overview
sources.currentness: W3C Recommendation 12 December 2024; overview updated May 2026
sources.learning: Use WCAG 2.2 as the current accessibility reference; preserve keyboard, focus visibility, target size, consistent help, accessible authentication and predictable error recovery.
sources.implementation: No visual churn; preserve strong system and add complete inventory/acceptance coverage.

sources.title: AI Risk Management Framework and Generative AI Profile
sources.currentness: AI RMF page current in July 2026; AI RMF 1.0 revision noted and GenAI Profile published July 2024
sources.learning: Keep AI risk governance, human oversight, source verification, fallback, monitoring, incident and revocation controls versioned and revalidated.
sources.implementation: AI remains assistive and not sole evidence; Tier A remains non-AI-capable.

sources.title: LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
sources.learning: Separate instructions from untrusted data, validate inputs and outputs, apply least privilege, monitoring, human controls and remote-content sanitization.
sources.implementation: Preserve untrusted-content boundary and no tool/action authority from imported text.

sources.publisher: New York State Unified Court System
sources.title: CourtHelp
sources.learning: Route self-represented users to official court information and free language-access resources; distinguish information and preparation from representation.
sources.implementation: Preserve official-resource routing and no-lawyer boundary.

sources.publisher: New York State Unified Court System
sources.title: DIY Forms
sources.learning: Guided answers may prepare a form or information sheet, but preparation must remain distinct from filing and court acceptance.
sources.implementation: Preserve form-state separation and official-source currentness.

sources.title: Lawyer Directory profile claiming FAQ
sources.learning: Free complete profile claiming and firm-authorized multi-profile control are understandable public patterns; paid placement should remain separately labeled.
sources.implementation: Already aligned: free factual control, separate paid membership and no hidden organic ranking.

sources.title: Attorney profile source and claim support
sources.learning: Source-derived profiles need visible correction and free claim/update paths; source collection does not eliminate correction risk.
sources.implementation: Preserve source dates, claim, correction, suppression and removal.

sources.title: Public attorney-plan and contract pages
sources.learning: Recurring plans need clear price, renewal, scope and separate attorney-engagement boundaries.
sources.implementation: Preserve monthly-only $15 manifest and closed checkout until exact acceptance; do not copy text, branding or trade dress.
